name: Portland Metro Summary
description: Metro-wide Portland housing market statistics for baseline comparison against target neighborhoods
geography: Portland city limits, Multnomah County primary, with reference to tri-county metro (Multnomah, Washington, Clackamas)

financing_environment.rate_trend: Rates stabilized in low-to-mid 6% range after 2025 cuts. Market expects modest further easing in late 2026.
financing_environment.lending_note: Conventional lending remains accessible. Hard money readily available for fix-and-flip. Some tightening on investment property loans — expect 25% minimum down for non-owner-occupied.

market_conditions.overall_trend: Moderate seller's market with balanced conditions emerging in outer neighborhoods
market_conditions.buyer_demand: Strong for move-in ready under $500K. First-time buyers active in $300K-$400K range.
market_conditions.investor_activity: Moderate — institutional investors less active than 2022 peak, local flippers and small investors filling gap
market_conditions.new_construction_impact: New construction permits stabilizing after 2024 slowdown. ADU permits remain strong statewide.
market_conditions.seasonal_note: Spring 2026 market showing typical seasonal uptick. Expect peak activity May-July.
market_conditions.rent_vs_buy: Renting still cheaper monthly in most neighborhoods, but price appreciation favors ownership for 3+ year hold.

target_neighborhood_comparison.note: Our 7 target neighborhoods are all below metro median, which is the point — we are targeting undervalued areas with upside.
target_neighborhood_comparison.avg_appreciation_premium: Target neighborhoods averaging 3.9% YoY vs 3.5% metro — outperforming
target_neighborhood_comparison.fastest_market: Woodstock at 16 DOM vs 22 metro average
target_neighborhood_comparison.slowest_market: Parkrose at 32 DOM vs 22 metro average

data_sources: RMLS (Regional Multiple Listing Service) — synthetic estimates based on public reporting
Oregon Association of Realtors market reports
Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey
